protocol.timestamp_precision_note: Recorded timestamp is end of the first authorized read call; no claim of sub-second exact first exposure.
protocol.raw_comparison_rule: Normalize glyphs①–⑤ to1–5, compare set(first.decision_codes) with set(blind.primary_code plus blind.additional_codes), ignore order, exclude conditional③ examples. Do not silently move prose-only holds into asserted arrays.
protocol.semantic_comparison_rule: Compare identity unit, edition, relationship direction, and conditionality in each scope statement. First-assessment evidence IDs are locators, not newly inspected behavior evidence.
protocol.independence_limit: Selected shared source packets and same tool ecosystem; different model/human independence unestablished. No statistical independent agreement rate, accuracy, kappa or adjudicated truth claimed.
protocol.conditional_split_rule: No actual mixed prior record was supplied for these six cases.③ is conditional only, excluded from observed-repair and error numerators.
